orchestrate.title: Single-contact Android delivery
preconditions: User outcome and inspected project/destination; repository instructions, Git changes and saved task state read.
steps: Classify the task or reconcile unfinished work and select scoped workflows.
Prepare applicable requirements/design documents and stop for human review before dependent implementation.
Dispatch ready specialists, accept actual outputs, return rework to its owner and pass stable artifacts to the next owner.
Run required checks and independent review; prepare the PR packet when in scope and stop before push/open actions.
Resume after the user decision, verify authorized external actions and report actual completion or blockers.
parallel: Independent research and disjoint-file tasks after stable contracts; no dependent work across an unapproved checkpoint.
failure: Record the resume point and stop dependent work on a failed gate, rejected handoff or pending human decision.
At most three targeted repairs per incident before escalation.
approval: Follow references/single-agent-delivery.md; prepare reviewable artifacts before asking for approval.
Only the user approves human checkpoints; bind decisions to artifact versions and reopen affected approvals on change.
Preserve explicit user overrides and separate release/publication/destructive-action authorization.
report: Scope, routes, accepted handoffs, actual checks, checkpoint decisions, artifacts/PR links, limitations and next action.
